label: AI JOBS
author: Mike

slides.headline: They've been searching [for months]
slides.body: Some of the people in the video say AI took their work. And the next jobs in line are the ones you were told a machine could never do.

slides.headline: Employers [named AI] as a reason
slides.body: Since {2023} the total is {193,226}. October was the lowest month of the year, only {1,265}.

slides.headline: The [quiet part]
slides.caption: Job postings in a year: companies are still hiring, they're just not hiring the beginners.

slides.headline: The jobs just [stopped showing up]
slides.stat_sub: less translation work in Western languages
slides.body: From over {3 million} freelance job posts, the first year after ChatGPT. Total freelance demand still went up.

slides.headline: A robot needs [a download]
slides.body: An electrician needs an apprenticeship. No robot fixes your outlet today, but my prediction is that by {2029}, one will.

slides.headline: Feeling safe isn't [being safe]
slides.caption: One poll in {March 2026}: most expect AI to cut jobs, only {30%} of workers worry about their own.

slides.headline: Watch the [full video]
slides.sub: AI Is Wiping Out All These Jobs

post.headline: AI is already taking jobs that felt safe just two years ago.
